risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company has established a dedicated Cybersecurity Committee reporting to the Board quarterly, and the CISO produces regular reports. This demonstrates high risk awareness and structured controls for sensitive data and intellectual property.

risks.title: Economic Fluctuations and Tariffs
risks.score_rationale: Since February 2025, US tariffs have impacted material costs and customer demand. While Jabil anticipates passing costs to customers, inability to fully recover costs could affect results.

risks.title: Customer Concentration
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily dependent on a few major customers, making it vulnerable to contract loss or demand reduction.

risks.title: Supply Chain Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to supply chain disruption risks, including component shortages and delivery delays, which affect the ability to serve customers.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations regarding data protection, product safety, and regional compliance across its multiple jurisdictions.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risks
risks.score_rationale: Jabil has labor and energy costs in local currencies outside the US, but most revenue and material costs are in US dollars. The company uses hedging instruments.

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to customer non-payment risk, though payment terms are managed via standard credit controls.

ai_positioning.summary: Jabil recognizes the growing importance of AI infrastructure within its Intelligent Infrastructure segment, which covers AI infrastructure solutions and cloud data center. However, no major proprietary AI strategy is detailed in the 10-K. AI is treated as an emerging end-user market and opportunity, rather than as transformational internal technology.
evidence: Segment Intelligent Infrastructure focused on artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure including revenues from customers in capital equipment and cloud data center infrastructure
References to capital equipment and cloud data center infrastructure as growth opportunities within AI ecosystems
